description: Figure 3.2 illustrates the ROUGE-1 score as a function of the adapter rank, denoted by log r, for four different fine-tuning configurations on the Gazeta dataset. The horizontal axis, labeled “log r”, spans a linear scale from 0 to 9, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The vertical axis, labeled “ROUGE-1”, ranges from 0 to 35, with major grid lines every 5 units. Four distinct lines, each marked with circular data points, represent the performance of different model-adapter combinations: “T5 + LoRA” (red), “MBart + LoRA” (purple), “T5 + AdaLoRA” (green), and “MBart + AdaLoRA” (orange). The red line (T5 + LoRA) remains relatively flat, starting at approximately 23.5 at log r = 0 and ending near 24.5 at log r = 9. The purple line (MBart + LoRA) begins at 5, dips to 2.5 at log r = 2, then rises sharply to 19 at log r = 4, and continues to climb to about 23.5 at log r = 9. The green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts at 23.5, increases steadily to 27 at log r = 4, and then plateaus near 30 from log r = 6 to 9. The orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) begins at 5, rises steeply to 32 at log r = 4, and then levels off slightly, remaining near 33.5 for log r values from 6 to 9.
